items.title: Alan Broadbent interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 26, 2023
items.q: Igor, who hated Mahler. ... Rimsky-Korsakov teaching Stravinsky.

ctx.x: There’s an interesting anecdote about when Stravinsky wrote the “Ebony Concerto” for the Woody Herman band, and it was apparently quite the scene. And Chubby Jackson talked about like what is this — this does not groove. © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-
That’s right. Stravinsky. Yeah. Well. I was going to mention something but I can’t — what were we talking about just before that?
We were talking about your “Variations on a Scene.”
